text: Swimming is an excellent form of exercise. It's a low-impact activity that can be done in either water or on land. To begin, one needs to locate a pool or a body of water suitable for swimming laps. Upon entering the water, goggles and a mask are necessary to protect the eyes and see the pool. Subsequently, as one swims, they develop their endurance and strength in their arm, shoulder, and leg muscles. Swimming is a fun, active way to stay healthy and have fun, while enjoying the company of others in a safe, controlled environment.
